Compression Quirk.name: Compression Quirk
Compression Quirk.description:
🔮 You shrink what you touch into a small glassy sphere and restore it at will. It is a showman's Quirk.

🌱 At the start you palm a weapon, a crate or a motorcycle into a marble-sized sphere in an instant, and feel through your palm what a wall or a rubble pile hides.
📈 With training: people carried out sealed safely inside, stored walls dropped in place, pocket ladders, villains removed, gangs disarmed at once, a falling tower pocketed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as tracking every sphere wears on your mind.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mr. Compress (Compress).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Sleight of Hand +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Disappearing Prop, Palm Survey
Compression Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the palm shrinks what it touches into a marble-sized sphere (or a player-picked shape) and snaps it back within about ten meters. A new adult user takes up to a motorcycle's size in a second, carries a handful of weightless spheres, and feels the shape of what the palm touches. People and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: no touch, no compression; walls, floors and fixed doors stay put. It never harms its contents; a person inside feels no time pass and comes out unhurt on their own within minutes. A broken sphere frees what it holds. Quirk Strain: light: an object in or out, reading a volume; moderate: a willing person, ranged release, climbing released objects; heavy: a resister, disarming a group; severe: signature, touchless compression. Type: Emitter. Law: compressing a person without consent is abduction; hiding goods in spheres is smuggling; licensed users take people only to rescue or arrest. Look: a blurred miniature inside; release pops.
